description: This file defines the 'File' class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing utility functions for handling files, especially ZIP archives, including validation, path resolution, temporary file creation, and existence checks.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Utility class for file operations within PhpSpreadsheet, including ZIP validation, path handling, and temporary file management.

methods.name: setUseUploadTempDirectory
methods.description: Sets whether to use the upload temporary directory for temporary files.

methods.name: getUseUploadTempDirectory
methods.description: Gets whether the upload temporary directory is used for temporary files.

methods.name: validateZipFirst4
methods.description: Validates the first four bytes of a ZIP file to check for correct signature.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists, including within ZIP archives.

methods.name: realpath
methods.description: Returns the canonicalized absolute pathname, supporting ZIP archives.

methods.name: sysGetTempDir
methods.description: Retrieves the system's temporary directory, optionally using upload temp directory.

methods.name: temporaryFilename
methods.description: Creates and returns a temporary filename.

methods.name: assertFile
methods.description: Asserts that a file exists and is readable; throws exception if not.

methods.name: testFileNoThrow
methods.description: Checks if a file exists and is readable, returning boolean instead of throwing exceptions.
